name: Production Intelligence Pipeline - Draft, Critique, Revise & Brief

parameters.text:
=You are an expert Principal Research Engineer. Analyze the following raw technical document/incident postmortem:

RAW INPUT:
{{ $json.body.raw_text }}

SOURCE METADATA:
Topic: {{ $json.body.topic }}
Source URL: {{ $json.body.source_url }}
Primary System: {{ $json.body.system_affected }}

TASK:
Extract structured findings according to the Stage 1 & 2 schema:
1. Core Root Cause / Architectural Driver
2. Key Quantitative Claims & Benchmarks
3. Critical Breaking Changes / Failure Vectors
4. Latency / Memory / Throughput Tradeoffs
5. Verifiable Source Citations

options.systemMessage: You are a senior systems engineer analyzing technical engineering sources. Never speculate or hallucinate. Ground every claim directly in the source text.

parameters.text:
=You are a Lead Backend Architect. Take the synthesized engineering findings below and draft a production-ready Technical Brief and Architecture RFC:

SYNTHESIZED FINDINGS:
{{ $json.text }}

Produce:
- Section 1: Executive Context & Incident/Update Synopsis
- Section 2: Architectural Deep-Dive & Root-Cause Mechanics
- Section 3: Concrete Code / Infrastructure Remediation Snippet
- Section 4: Production Rollout Risk & Migration Matrix

options.systemMessage: Draft actionable, authoritative technical briefs. Avoid fluff or generic high-level summaries. Include precise configuration flags, parameters, and architectural diagrams.

parameters.text:
=You are an Adversarial Red Team Reviewer and Staff Systems Auditor. Ruthlessly critique the drafted technical brief against the raw source:

DRAFT UNDER REVIEW:
{{ $json.text }}

RAW SOURCE CONTEXT:
{{ $('Webhook Trigger').first().json.body.raw_text }}

EVALUATION DIMENSIONS:
1. Factual Grounding & Hallucinations: Did the draft invent any flags, configuration keys, or performance statistics?
2. Operational Hazards: Will the proposed code cause deadlocks, race conditions, memory leaks, or connection exhaustion under high concurrency?
3. Omissions: Did the draft miss critical prerequisites, deprecation warnings, or rollback procedures?

Provide structured feedback categorized into: [CRITICAL DEFECT], [OPERATIONAL RISK], and [SUGGESTED REVISION].

options.systemMessage: You are a merciless technical auditor. Your job is to catch dangerous omissions and fabricated claims before code touches production.

parameters.text:
=Revise the Technical Brief by strictly integrating all valid critiques from the audit report:

ORIGINAL DRAFT:
{{ $('Step 3: Draft Architecture Brief').first().json.text }}

AUDIT CRITIQUE:
{{ $json.text }}

OUTPUT REQUIREMENTS:
Deliver the final publication-ready brief in clean, standardized GitHub-flavored Markdown:
- Title & Executive Status Badge
- Context & Root-Cause Mechanics
- Validated Implementation Snippet
- Operational Pre-Flight Checklist
- Audit Sign-off Table (listing critiques addressed)

options.systemMessage: Format the final output cleanly. Integrate all valid critique points, remove any debunked assumptions, and ensure complete code blocks.
